name: Heading Style
description: Adds CSS classes to selected heading tags (h1–h6) via configuration.
project_description:
Heading Style

 Overview

 Heading Style is a Drupal module that allows site administrators to

apply CSS classes to HTML heading tags (h1–h6) using a configuration form.

 The module automatically:

Reads available CSS classes from a CSS file

Allows selecting classes via UI (no manual typing)

Applies styles to headings inside Body fields, CKEditor, Views, and other text fields

Updates output immediately using proper cache invalidation
